84:   const state = new Map<string, number>();
85:   const stack: string[] = [];

88:     state.set(id, 1);
89:     stack.push(id);
90:     for (const dependency of dependencies.get(id)!) {
91:       if (state.get(dependency) === 1) {
92:         const start = stack.indexOf(dependency);
93:         return [...stack.slice(start), dependency];
94:       }
95:       if (!state.has(dependency)) {
96:         const cycle = visit(dependency);
97:         if (cycle) return cycle;
98:       }
99:     }
100:     stack.pop();
101:     state.set(id, 2);
102:     return undefined;
103:   }
104: 
105:   for (const id of [...dependencies.keys()].sort(compareIds)) {
106:     if (!state.has(id)) {
107:       const cycle = visit(id);
108:       if (cycle) return cycle;
109:     }
110:   }
111:   return [];

114: export function createPlan(tasks: Task[]): Plan {
115:   const byId = new Map(tasks.map((task) => [task.id, task]));
116:   const dependents = new Map(tasks.map((task) => [task.id, [] as string[]]));
117:   const remaining = new Map(tasks.map((task) => [task.id, task.dependsOn.length]));
118:   for (const task of tasks) {
119:     for (const dependency of task.dependsOn) dependents.get(dependency)!.push(task.id);
120:   }
121:   for (const values of dependents.values()) values.sort(compareIds);
122: 
123:   const ready = tasks.filter((task) => task.dependsOn.length === 0).map((task) => task.id).sort(compareIds);
124:   const order: string[] = [];
125:   while (ready.length > 0) {
126:     const id = ready.shift()!;
127:     order.push(id);
128:     for (const dependent of dependents.get(id)!) {
129:       const count = remaining.get(dependent)! - 1;
130:       remaining.set(dependent, count);
131:       if (count === 0) {
132:         ready.push(dependent);
133:         ready.sort(compareIds);
134:       }
135:     }
136:   }
137: 
138:   if (order.length !== tasks.length) {
139:     throw new Error(`cycle detected: ${findCycle(tasks).join(" -> ")}`);
140:   }

142:   const layers: string[][] = [];
143:   const layerById = new Map<string, number>();
144:   const earliest: Record<string, { start: number; finish: number }> = {};
145:   const pathById = new Map<string, string[]>();
146:   for (const id of order) {
147:     const task = byId.get(id)!;
148:     const layer = task.dependsOn.length === 0
149:       ? 0
150:       : Math.max(...task.dependsOn.map((dependency) => layerById.get(dependency)!)) + 1;
151:     layerById.set(id, layer);
152:     (layers[layer] ??= []).push(id);
153: 
154:     let start = 0;
155:     let path: string[] = [];
156:     for (const dependency of task.dependsOn) {
157:       const finish = earliest[dependency]!.finish;
158:       const candidate = pathById.get(dependency)!;
159:       if (finish > start || (finish === start && (path.length === 0 || comparePaths(candidate, path) < 0))) {
160:         start = finish;
161:         path = candidate;
162:       }
163:     }
164:     earliest[id] = { start, finish: start + task.duration };
165:     pathById.set(id, [...path, id]);
166:   }
167:   for (const layer of layers) layer.sort(compareIds);
168: 
169:   const totalDuration = order.length === 0 ? 0 : Math.max(...order.map((id) => earliest[id]!.finish));
170:   let criticalPath: string[] = [];
171:   for (const id of order) {
172:     const path = pathById.get(id)!;
173:     if (earliest[id]!.finish === totalDuration &&
174:         (criticalPath.length === 0 || comparePaths(path, criticalPath) < 0)) {
175:       criticalPath = path;
176:     }
177:   }
178: 
179:   return { order, layers, earliest, totalDuration, criticalPath };
